empires.name: The Roman Empire
empires.note: They do not need to beat you in one season. Roads that carry a legion faster than your riders, siege engines that arrive assembled, and a fortified camp dug fresh every night they march.

places.name: Roma
places.note: The throne. Seven hills behind stone, and every road you would run away on was built by them.

places.name: Mediolanum
places.note: Where the legions winter until the passes open. Come in the wrong month and they are all still here.

places.name: Lugdunum
places.note: The mint. Silver leaves by cart under a guard of clerks and one bored cohort.

places.name: Carthago
places.note: Rebuilt on the ashes of the old city. Grain sheds, tax chests, a garrison that has not fought in a generation.

places.name: Ostia
places.note: Rome's mouth. Warehouses stacked with Egyptian grain and no wall worth the name.

places.name: Capua
places.note: Gladiator schools and fat farmland - armed men everywhere, and none of them loyal.

places.name: Massilia
places.note: Old Greek stock paying Roman taxes. The market is rich, the walls are an afterthought.

places.name: Pompeii
places.note: Wine, fish sauce, and rich villas under a mountain that has been quiet a long while.

places.name: Tibur
places.note: Senators keep summer houses up by the waterfalls. Plate and silver, no soldiers.

empires.name: The Greek City-States
empires.note: Long spears in close order - a wall from the front, ruin from the flank. They have been cutting each other's throats for a hundred years, so whichever city you burn, the next one over will call it justice.

places.name: Athenai
places.note: The throne. Silver from the hill mines pays for the walls, and the walls are new.

places.name: Sparta
places.note: No walls at all. They think the men standing in front of the town are the walls, and so far they have been right.

places.name: Korinthos
places.note: Sits on the neck of land everything must cross. Rich on tolls, and a fortress rock above it.

places.name: Miletos
places.note: Far from Athenai and it knows it. Wool, pottery kilns, and a garrison that answers slowly.

places.name: Thebai
places.note: The best spearmen in the field and the worst neighbours. They will march on Sparta the week you arrive.

places.name: Argos
places.note: Old horse country in the plain. It has hated Sparta longer than anyone can remember.

places.name: Mytilene
places.note: Olive presses and wine on a wide bay. Pays Athenai in coin and grudges.

places.name: Delphoi
places.note: A goat track up a cliff to a shrine every city has filled with gold. Guarded by priests.

places.name: Marathon
places.note: Fennel plain and a burial mound. A day's march from Athenai, which is the whole problem.
